name: Avatares AI - Admin - Upsert Ingest Profile

parameters.jsCode:
function sql(value) {
  if (value === undefined || value === null || value === '') return 'NULL';
  return `'${String(value).replace(/'/g, "''")}'`;
}

function bool(value) {
  return value === true || value === 'true' ? 'true' : 'false';
}

const body = $json.body || {};

const profileName = body.profileName || `${body.avatar || 'estefania-montealegre'} / ${body.scene || 'coffee-rain'} / ${body.assetType || 'raw-image'}`;
const avatar = body.avatar || 'estefania-montealegre';
const avatarShort = body.avatarShort || body.avatar_short || 'estefania';
const scene = body.scene || 'coffee-rain';
const assetType = body.assetType || body.asset_type || 'raw-image';
const workflow = body.workflow || 'flux-krea-dev';
const model = body.model || 'flux-krea-dev';
const seed = body.seed === undefined || body.seed === null || body.seed === '' ? 'NULL' : Number(body.seed);
const version = body.version === undefined || body.version === null || body.version === '' ? 1 : Number(body.version);
const autoPromoteLatest = bool(body.autoPromoteLatest ?? body.auto_promote_latest ?? false);
const setActive = body.setActive === true || body.isActive === true;

let query = `
WITH upserted AS (
  INSERT INTO ingest_profiles (
    profile_name,
    avatar,
    avatar_short,
    scene,
    asset_type,
    workflow,
    model,
    seed,
    version,
    auto_promote_latest,
    is_active,
    is_enabled
  )
  VALUES (
    ${sql(profileName)},
    ${sql(avatar)},
    ${sql(avatarShort)},
    ${sql(scene)},
    ${sql(assetType)},
    ${sql(workflow)},
    ${sql(model)},
    ${seed},
    ${version},
    ${autoPromoteLatest},
    false,
    true
  )
  ON CONFLICT (avatar, scene, asset_type, workflow, model, version)
  DO UPDATE SET
    profile_name = EXCLUDED.profile_name,
    avatar_short = EXCLUDED.avatar_short,
    seed = EXCLUDED.seed,
    auto_promote_latest = EXCLUDED.auto_promote_latest,
    is_enabled = true,
    updated_at = now()
  RETURNING *
)
`;

if (setActive) {
  query += `,
deactivated AS (
  UPDATE ingest_profiles
  SET is_active = false, updated_at = now()
  WHERE is_active = true
  RETURNING profile_id
),
activated AS (
  UPDATE ingest_profiles p
  SET is_active = true, updated_at = now()
  FROM upserted u
  WHERE p.profile_id = u.profile_id
  RETURNING p.*
)
SELECT
  profile_id AS "profileId",
  profile_name AS "profileName",
  avatar,
  avatar_short AS "avatarShort",
  scene,
  asset_type AS "assetType",
  workflow,
  model,
  seed,
  version,
  auto_promote_latest AS "autoPromoteLatest",
  is_active AS "isActive",
  is_enabled AS "isEnabled",
  created_at AS "createdAt",
  updated_at AS "updatedAt"
FROM activated;`;
} else {
  query += `SELECT
  profile_id AS "profileId",
  profile_name AS "profileName",
  avatar,
  avatar_short AS "avatarShort",
  scene,
  asset_type AS "assetType",
  workflow,
  model,
  seed,
  version,
  auto_promote_latest AS "autoPromoteLatest",
  is_active AS "isActive",
  is_enabled AS "isEnabled",
  created_at AS "createdAt",
  updated_at AS "updatedAt"
FROM upserted;`;
}

return { json: { query } };
